stemMd: A line crosses the y-axis at −4 and rises 3 units for every 2 units moved to the right. Which equation represents it?
explanationMd: Slope is rise divided by run, 3/2, and the y-intercept is −4. Substitute both into y=mx+b to obtain the equation.

distractorRationale.d: This uses the wrong intercept sign.
distractorRationale.c: This confuses the rise and run with slope and intercept.
distractorRationale.a: This slopes down rather than up.
